Close: going (gati — the journeying-verb inside stillness: spotless going = motionless motion). Rejected: 'acupuncture' — killed: needle-etc kept (tīkṣṇa-sūcyādi as class); 'maraṇa-yoga' — killed: nothing dying here — going kept.
